scope: Theorem-like environments in recursively included TeX files; prose/equation coverage and dependencies require review. No proof truth is assigned by this inventory.

equation_components.label: eq:p0-apollonius-pencil
coverage: Actual complex norm factorization and guarded modulus-to-distance equivalence. Nonzero A,C, distinct finite foci from nonzero determinant, and explicit denominator/pole exclusion.

Nonnegative-weight squaring equivalence; the nonunit locus is an actual Euclidean complex metric sphere with derived center and radius; the unit locus is the vertical metric bisector for distinct real foci.
Degenerate zero/negative parameters, equal-focus and totalized-pole counterexamples, actual positive-radius formula and upper-plane witnesses, and the final guarded Mobius circle/line classification.

equation_components.label: eq:p0-prefix-matrices
coverage: The chronological matrix prefix acts as the previously certified chronological prefix of bijections, for arbitrary finite nondegenerate histories.

All eight pure-slot matrices interpret existing Chapter 2 partial semantics. Nondegeneracy, chronological products, tree correspondence and ordinary evaluation iff every projective state stays finite are certified.

equation_components.label: eq:p0-affine-stabilizer
coverage: The actual infinity stabilizer criterion is C=0, and its action has the explicit affine translation/dilation factorization. The abstract Aff/PGL group isomorphism is not identified here.

The actual infinity stabilizer is multiplicatively equivalent to standard Mathlib AffineEquiv K K K. Unique nonzero-slope normal form, finite evaluation, inverse formula, parameter composition and properness witnesses are explicit.
Pure first-slot nondegenerate arithmetic words have image exactly the affine stabilizer; every ordinary input is admissible. Affine normal forms have explicit two-step arithmetic realizations.

Actual point stabilizers are conjugate. The gauge J*T(-q) sends q to infinity, and conjugates the finite-point stabilizer to B infinity. Standard affine equivalences give the inverse-conjugated subgroup. Fixed-pole fibers instead are right cosets B infinity * gauge(q), are not subgroups, and exclude the stabilizer of q.

equation_components.label: eq:p0-projective-factorization
coverage: The four-factor projective formula holds as matrices up to the explicit nonzero scalar 1/C and as total actions, including infinity and intermediate poles.

equation_components.label: eq:p0-bruhat
coverage: The actual group is the disjoint union of B infinity and the double coset B infinity * J * B infinity. The second cell is exactly the complement, C nonzero on representatives, equivalently a finite pole, and the union of finite-pole affine gauge cosets.
